name: Pulsar Xlite Wireless
notes: 87-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Pulsar Xlite Wireless, from a dump of the device: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/de78986ee6ddd8ed300d0f20e59e0bfd/pulsar-xlite-v2-1000hz. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
